$comment: Node-run tooling (scripts/**), typechecked separately from the app. These files execute directly under Node's native type stripping, so the config is stricter about what TypeScript may be written than the app's: only ERASABLE syntax (no enums, namespaces or parameter properties, which stripping cannot emit) and explicit `import type`. The app config is extended for strictness and paths, then re-pointed at Node instead of the DOM and React Native.
